question: Will Thursday's White House talks bring another Oleshky truce, yes or no?
hook_lines: UKRAINE GIVES MELANIA TRUMP TOP ORDER

lines.text: Ukraine has given Melania Trump its Order of Princess Olga, first class.
The decree cites her significant personal contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine.

scene.quote: significant personal contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine

lines.text: It follows a five-day ceasefire around Russian-occupied Oleshky, which ended on the first of November.
Several hundred civilians were evacuated, the BBC and Kyiv Post report.
About eighty per cent chose Ukrainian-controlled territory, Kyiv Post reports.
Kyiv Post says several hundred, perhaps up to a thousand, still remain in the town.
On Thursday, Russian and Ukrainian delegations meet at the White House, on Melania Trump's invitation.
Ukraine sends ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets and MP Davyd Arakhamia.
The Kremlin says Russia sends ombudsman Yana Lantratova and Kirill Dmitriev.
Lubinets says similar evacuations could be organised every month, Kyiv Post reports.
Some Ukrainian soldiers say Russia used the pause to rotate troops. Lubinets disputes that.
Lubinets said: There are important meetings ahead.
Will Thursday's White House talks bring another Oleshky truce, yes or no?
